text.description_html:
PBB-DA816045, 6" x 4-1/2" Double Acting Spring Hinge, Pair

6" x 4-1/2" Double Acting Spring Hinge. Mortise Type for use on Hollow Metal Doors (4-1/2" Template Hole Pattern) - Door flange is mortised into edge of door. Jamb flange is surface applied to door jamb. For doors 1-3/4" thick. Packaged with 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws.

The PBB-DA816045 6" x 4.5" is the correct spring hinge when you are installing a 1-3/4" thick metal door that has normal hinge locations with a 4-1/2" template pattern.

Specifications of the PBB-DA816045 Double Acting Spring Hinge:

  • Material: Steel
  • Hinge Size: 6"
  • Door Leaf: 4-1/2" Template Pattern
  • Jamb Leaf: 6" Non-template Pattern
  • Non-Handed
  • Barrel Diameter: 1.18"
  • Hinge Type: Mortise
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Maximum Swing: 90º each direction
  • PBB DA816045 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

    • PBB-DA816045 Hinge Selection for Maximum Door Size

    Door Weight Door Width Door Weight Door Width

    Note: Do Not use on Doors with Hinge Edge Beveled.

    Sold as a pair (2 Hinges)
